subject: Recap + next steps: PO vs card and vendor onboarding for Redwood trial
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Asha Patel <asha.patel@nimbusretail.com>, Tim O'Leary <tim.oleary@nimbusretail.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-20T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Recap + next steps: PO vs card and vendor onboarding for Redwood trial

Hi Asha / Tim — thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment: 

Summary of what you shared:
- Goal: run a 4–6 week proof-of-concept across 2 internal apps to validate latency/cost tradeoffs and integration with your ingest pipeline.
- Expected consumption: ~300K tokens/mo initial, could scale if results look good.
- Procurement constraints: Finance owns vendor onboarding — vendor creation + W9 + insurance is required for PO issuance; card payments ok for small pilots.
- Timeline constraint: procurement flagged a 3–4 week lead time for vendor setup if started now.

Questions / asks for Nimbus:
1) Do you have an internal dollar threshold where AP will only accept PO (e.g., >$10k/month)?
2) Who is the procurement/finance contact (name + email) to get the vendor form started?
3) Are you interested in starting via AWS/Azure marketplace procurement if available, or do you prefer direct PO?

Suggested path from Redwood to minimize time-to-value:
- Option A (fast): Start pilot on a credit card for <$5k to unblock engineering quickly while procurement completes vendor onboarding.
- Option B (preferred for production): Kick off vendor creation now and issue a PO for monthly committed capacity once onboarded (Net30 typical).

I attached a one-page survey (Redwood_po_vs_card_survey.pdf) and a lightweight SOW template (SOW_template.docx) to help procurement and your legal team review scope and terms.

If you can reply with 1) AP contact, 2) preferred initial payment method (card vs PO for pilot), and 3) any compliance requirements (insurance limits, special tax forms), we can put together a mutual action plan this week.

Thanks —
Karthik
Enterprise Solutions
Redwood Inference
attachments: Redwood_po_vs_card_survey.pdf, SOW_template.docx
From: Asha Patel <asha.patel@nimbusretail.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tim O'Leary <tim.oleary@nimbusretail.com>, procure@nimbusretail.com
Date: 2026-11-20T11:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Recap + next steps: PO vs card and vendor onboarding for Redwood trial

Hi Karthik — thanks for the summary and for capturing options clearly. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Our AP policy: we typically require a PO for any recurring spend anticipated above $10k/month. For one-off or short pilots under $5k we allow credit card payments to simplify procurement.
- Vendor onboarding: we need vendor creation (form + W9 + insurance) completed before legal can sign a master services agreement; procurement estimates 3 weeks once we get the completed packet.
- Marketplace: we can consider AWS Marketplace but that usually adds licensing flow constraints; prefer direct PO for production.

Procurement/Finance contact: procure@nimbusretail.com (cc'd) — they will share the vendor packet and next steps.

We'll review the SOW template and the survey and circle back with the vendor packet by EOD Wednesday.

Best,
Asha Patel
Head of Platform Product
Nimbus Retail
attachments: procurement_policy.pdf
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Asha Patel <asha.patel@nimbusretail.com>, Tim O'Leary <tim.oleary@nimbusretail.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-20T13:20:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Recap + next steps: PO vs card and vendor onboarding for Redwood trial

Thanks Asha — that aligns with what we heard. Quick response with proposed actions so we can move forward: 

- We can do Option A (card-based pilot) for an initial $3k proof-of-concept to get your engineering team unblocked this week.
- Simultaneously, please have procurement start the vendor creation packet (procure@nimbusretail.com) so we can transition to a PO for production.
- I'll prepare a short mutual action plan (MAP) that lists deliverables, acceptance criteria, and timelines for both the pilot and the PO onboarding path.

Marissa / Rishi (cc) — FYI: if procurement needs any standard Redwood tax or insurance docs, let me know and I'll surface them.

Quoted for context: 
> On 2026-11-20 11:03 AM Asha Patel <asha.patel@nimbusretail.com> wrote:
> > Our AP policy: we typically require a PO for any recurring spend anticipated above $10k/month. For one-off or short pilots under $5k we allow credit card payments to simplify procurement.
> > Procurement/Finance contact: procure@nimbusretail.com (cc'd) — they will share the vendor packet and next steps.

I'll follow up with a MAP doc and a payment link for the $3k pilot unless you want a different amount.

-Karthik
attachments: Redwood_po_vs_card_survey.pdf
From: Tim O'Leary <tim.oleary@nimbusretail.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Asha Patel <asha.patel@nimbusretail.com>
Cc: procure@nimbusretail.com, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-22T15:43:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Recap + next steps: PO vs card and vendor onboarding for Redwood trial

Karthik / Asha — following up after procurement dug into timelines. A couple of confirmations from finance: 

- We can accept a credit card payment for the pilot (recommend the $3k you proposed) to start ASAP.
- For production, Finance will issue Net30 on PO once vendor onboarding is complete. Expect vendor creation to take ~3 business weeks after we receive the completed packet.
- Please send a standard PO template and any required Redwood tax / insurance forms so procurement can pre-populate.

Attaching our PO template and vendor onboarding instructions to make the handoff easier. I'll ask procure@nimbusretail.com to reach out directly if they need any missing docs.

Looking forward to the MAP — happy to get the pilot started this week.

Thanks,
Tim O'Leary
VP, Finance Operations
Nimbus Retail
attachments: PO_template.pdf, Vendor_onboarding_instructions.pdf
